title: India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates
full_text: Skip to main content By Matthew Carey Matthew Carey Documentary Editor, Awards @mattcarey More Stories By Matthew Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates Oscar Winner David Dinerstein Boards ‘Room Of The Absolute’ As EP; Award-Winning Doc Creates Portrait Of Ukrainian Artist Alla Hurenko View All November 11, 2026 1:02am Add us as a Google Preferred Source YIFF EXCLUSIVE: The upcoming Yellowstone International Film Festival in Mumbai, India has announced its documentary lineup, highlighted by the Asian premiere of Oscar contender American Doctor . Director Poh Si Teng’s film examines three U.S. physicians who volunteered their medical expertise to treat Palestinian children severely injured in Israel’s sustained attack on Gaza (it screens Thursday at DOC NYC after being named to that festival’s prestigious shortlist). Joining American Doctor at the Yellowstone festival will be fellow documentary feature Herland , directed by Kallol Mukherjee, also making its Asian premiere. “In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control,” reads a description. “As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?” Related Stories News Watermelon Pictures Co-Founders Talk Future Plans & Growing Hollywood Support For Palestinian Stories: "We've Been Seeing A Renaissance With A Lot Of The A-Listers" Documentary Inaugural West Hollywood Human Rights Film Festival To Showcase Oscar-Contending Documentaries, 20th Anniversary Screening Of 'Blood Diamond' YIFF Documentary feature The Wolf , directed by Wancheng Gu and Prasad Shetty, “follows Yuan, a 60-year-old queer former village mayor in Shanghai, as she navigates love, family obligations, and shifting economic landscapes while seeking autonomy and reinvention later in life.” Watch on Deadline The Yellowstone International Film Festival runs from November 30 to December 4 in Mumbai, capital of the Indian state of Maharashtra. Among the short documentaries programmed in the festival is Born Secret , directed by Riley Fitchpatrick, in which the filmmaker “returns to his hometown that built the atomic bomb . ” Scroll for the list of doc shorts in the lineup. YIFF YIFF also revealed its slate of LGBTQIA+-themed films. In addition to documentary The Wolf , features include Elephants in the Fog , winner of the Jury Prize in the Un Certain Regard section of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival. The film directed by Abinash Bikram Shah “follows Pirati, matriarch of a Kinnar (Trans) community in a Nepalese village, who dreams of escaping to a normal life. When one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility.” Tank Time (LGBTQIA Short) – A lonely, nonbinary teen finds courage, friendship, and a glimmer of magic in a stolen fish, a petty neighborhood feud, and an unexpected crush. Filmmaker – Jess Burgess; Country – United States; Runtime -16:39 The Witch of Vihar Lake (LGBTQIA Short) Mitthu, a timid young boy and his teenage sister Ishita live in a village close to Vihar Lake, where stories of a terrifying witch prevail. The village locals don’t dare go close to the forest or the haunted lake. Mystery and magic surround the siblings as they grapple with their parents’ ignorance and anger. We follow a bewitched Ishita and Mitthu in their coming-of-age journey as the threat of the witch looms over their lives. Filmmaker – Joey Kaushik; Country – India; Runtime – 10:47 The Sailor & The Chef – ( LGBTQIA+ Doc Short) Piyush & Sushil met entirely by chance 30 years ago at a theatre in Mumbai, India. Unbeknownst to each other, they were both gay & seeking partners in a time when the internet was nascent, and there was barely any out & proud queer community. Filmmaker- Ashish Sawhny; Country – India; Runtime -20:23 At this year’s festival, YIFF launches the inaugural KSF Queer Grant, in association with the Keshav Suri Foundation (KSF) and Lotus Visual Productions, committing $20,000 USD “towards the production of independent films by emerging LGBTQIA+ filmmakers in India. The initiative will select two filmmakers, each receiving $10,000 USD in production funding, alongside a nine-month program of industry mentorship and end-to-end creative and production support.” The grant has been established with a three-year commitment to ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of the initiative, YIFF notes. “Over the course of these three years, the collaborating organizations aim to support six filmmakers in producing six films, providing emerging queer storytellers with the resources and opportunities to bring their stories to life and share them with the world.” Tushar Tyagi, founder of Yellowstone International Film Festival YIFF Yellowstone International Film Festival founder Tushar Tyagi said, “Talent and compelling stories exist everywhere, but the opportunity to bring them to life is not always accessible to everyone. For many queer filmmakers in India, the challenge is not a lack of imagination or stories to tell, but access to the resources, industry networks and support needed to turn their creative vision into a film. Through this grant, we want to help bridge that gap by giving filmmakers the freedom and means to tell their stories with honesty and authenticity.” Tyagi continued, “Our ambition is to nurture a new generation of queer Indian voices, bring narratives rooted in lived experiences to the screen, and create opportunities for these stories to travel beyond borders. These stories deserve not only to be told, but to be seen, heard and celebrated by audiences around the world.” Keshav Suri, founder of the Keshav Suri Foundation YIFF Keshav Suri, founder of the Keshav Suri Foundation, commented, “Representation in cinema must go beyond having LGBTQIA+ characters on screen. It is equally important that people from the community have the resources and creative freedom to tell their own stories. There is no shortage of talent or compelling stories within the community, but access to funding and industry opportunities remains a challenge. Through this grant, we want to help bridge that gap and give more queer filmmakers the opportunity to bring their stories to life.” Neeraj Churi, founder of Lotus Visual Productions YIFF “For too long, queer filmmakers in India have faced challenges in securing funding and finding the right partners to bring their creative visions to life,” said Neeraj Churi, founder of Lotus Visual Productions and Sundance-winning producer of Cactus Pears . “And yet, some of the most exciting and original voices in Indian cinema are emerging from within the LGBTQIA+ community. We believe these filmmakers should have the opportunity to tell their own stories, on their own terms. The KSF Queer Grant is about creating that opportunity, combining financial support with mentorship and practical filmmaking guidance. Our hope is that this initiative will not only help make two films possible, but also open doors for a new generation of queer storytellers.” In addition to The Sailor & The Chef and Born Secret noted above, these are the short documentaries programmed in the 7 th edition of the Yellowstone International Film Festival: In the Silence After – (Doc Short) A son returns home to care for his mother, filming the last year they will spend together. Filmmaker – Sebastian Delascasas; Country – Colombia, United States; Runtime -16:50 No Matter the Weather – (Doc Short) Renée, 83, broke her ankle. Fortunately, she can rely on her granddaughter Florence, who steps in as her caregiver. While this ordeal brings them closer than ever, it inevitably confronts them with the reality of Renée’s decline. Filmmaker – Florence Lafond; Country – Canada; Runtime -14:30 A Sunflower in Delhi – (Doc Short) In a tiny women’s only beauty parlour, generations of devoted customers, including the filmmaker’s family, reflect on letting their hair go grey. The film meanders between the intimate oasis of the Sunflower Chinese Beauty Parlour and the bustling city landscape outside. title: Web Summit Cancels Day Two As Storm Charles Hits Lisbon
full_text: Skip to main content By Stewart Clarke Stewart Clarke More Stories By Stewart Web Summit Cancels Day Two As Storm Charles Hits Lisbon ‘The Perfect Lie’ Actor Matthijs Van De Sande Bakhuyzen To Lead AFM-Bound Arctic Thriller ‘The Art Of Survival’ M. John Harrison Wins The 2026 Booker Prize With ‘The End Of Everything’ View All November 11, 2026 1:05am Add us as a Google Preferred Source L-R: Lucy Hyslop, Brooke Stites, Jess Kirkman Tyler Miller/Web Summit, Sportsfile, Getty Images Storm Charles has put paid to day two of Web Summit in Lisbon , Portugal. Organizers said it had shut down for the day on government advice and expects to be back up and running for day three on Thursday, November 12. Web Summit is an enormous event, attracting 70,000 attendees including tech leaders and politicians from around the world, as well as media execs and sports stars. Organizers notified delegates and speakers of the day two cancellation overnight. The Prime Minister of Portugal Luís Montenegro said Tuesday that his office had recommended Web Summit events be suspended given the expected impact of two storms, Bruna and Charles. He added the final decision rested with Web Summit organizers, who quickly decided to heed his advice. Related Stories News SAG-AFTRA Members Ratify TV Animation Contracts, Securing 12.6% Wage Increase For Voice Actors News SAG-AFTRA Votes To Extend Duncan Crabtree-Ireland's Contract With Updated Title Schools and shops have been closed in Lisbon, and local transport and non-essential public services are shutting down. Some flights have been delayed and cancelled. Watch on Deadline “The Government of Portugal has formally advised Web Summit that, due to the risks posed by Storm Charles, including tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport and the impact of high winds on external structures, Day 2 of Web Summit should not take place,” organizers said. “This follows discussions with the Portuguese Government, the National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority (ANEPC), and the Public Security Police (PSP). Web Summit will of course respect the Government’s direction, and accordingly, Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place.” Organizers said they are working with the authorities and emergency services to monitor conditions but expect to proceed with events on Thursday as the storm passes. The day three lineup on Thursday is slated to include SAG AFTRA boss Duncan Crabtree-Ireland in a session entitled Hollywood’s Identity Crisis, moderated by Deadline. title: Comedian Lucy Beaumont Fears Being Blacklisted By TV Industry After Blowing Whistle On David Walliams
full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake Channel 4 Becomes Latest Network To Delete David Walliams Shows MGM+ Greenlights Gilded Age-Era Series ‘The American Heiress’ Starring Julianna Margulies Netflix Refuses To Remove Russell Brand Stand-Up Special Featuring Crude Sex Joke View All November 11, 2026 1:13am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Lucy Beaumont Sky News Comedian Lucy Beaumont has said she has risked her television career by speaking out about David Walliams because the industry doesn’t tolerate troublemakers. In an interview with Sky News (watch below), the Taskmaster star and Hullraisers writer revealed that she was one of the “whistleblowers” on Walliams, who has been accused of using his fame and power to prey on teenage girls. Walliams, known for Little Britain and Doctor Who , strongly denies wrongdoing. Beaumont told The Cathy Newman Show that a young person working on a TV show approached her with concerns that Walliams allegedly hosted teenagers in his dressing room. Beaumont said she contacted one of the young girls. Related Stories News David Walliams Being Cut From New Movie 'Fing!' Following Allegations; Comcast-Owned Sky Exits UK Distribution Of Film News 'Britain's Got Talent' Producer Urges "Anyone Who Feels They Have Been Subject Of Wrongdoing" To Come Forward Following David Walliams Allegations “She was in a really bad way,” Beaumont said. “I was really worried she was going to take her own life because of it. She had put stuff online, and there was evidence that she was in a dressing room. I offered to pay legal fees to try and get her some protection — and I’m not saying necessarily that what she said was true — but I wanted to help her because it was a world that she was really out of her depth with.” Watch on Deadline Beaumont continued: “I believe she had signed an NDA [non-disclosure agreement] to say — and this is the issue with some of these NDAs — the NDA wasn’t just about she couldn’t talk to the media. It was that she couldn’t — I’m nearly crying telling you this — talk to family or friends or a therapist.” She added: “There’s no proper duty of care. There’s no social services that you deal with, and it’s partly because the industry is very well-managed.” Turning to her decision to speak out, Beaumont said she doesn’t think she will work in television again because people “lose work” for challenging high-profile individuals and are painted as a “trouble causer.” She added that people are “very replaceable” in the business and there are “lots of other people who can do your job.” Beaumont joked that she would become a Pilates teacher. ITV News and The Guardian published their investigation into Walliams on Tuesday, detailing how he allegedly used his position on shows like Little Britain and Britain’s Got Talent to meet teenagers and pursue sexual contact with them. One of the teenagers was alleged to be 15 at the time of her interaction with Walliams. Beaumont said she spoke to The Guardian as part of its reporting. “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law,” Walliams told ITV News. “I am devastated that some of the women I met ten to twenty years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me.” He continued: “Looking back, I realise that at times I behaved thoughtlessly towards other people I had casual sexual relationships with… I realise I did not always take people’s feelings properly into account. That is something I regret. And whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline Thriller ‘The Writer’; Latest News ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Read More About: 1 Comments

title: Jonathan Ross Explains Backstory Behind “Tasteless” David Walliams Joke
full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max James Graham’s BBC Drama ‘Sherwood’ To End After Season 3 Netflix’s ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ Beats ‘Mr Nobody Against Putin’ To Top Prize At UK Grierson Documentary Awards How The ‘Married At First Sight UK’ Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World View All November 11, 2026 1:39am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Jonathan Ross Lia Toby/Getty for the NTA's British TV presenter Jonathan Ross has landed himself in some hot water over the past week for his past association with both David Walliams and Russell Brand . The Guardian and ITV News’ report into allegations against Walliams including from teenagers referenced a joke Ross made at the 2004 British Comedy Awards. “The comedy awards is 15 years old – 15 years old! And like most 15-year-olds, it’s drunk, it’s unpredictable and it’s probably going home with David Walliams,” Ross joked at the time. Ross addressed the joke and the broader allegations this morning, saying in a statement he is “as horrified by the revelations about David Walliams and the crimes of Russell Brand as the rest of the nation.” Related Stories News Comedian Lucy Beaumont Fears Being Blacklisted By TV Industry After Blowing Whistle On David Walliams News David Walliams Being Cut From New Movie 'Fing!' Following Allegations; Comcast-Owned Sky Exits UK Distribution Of Film Ross said the “tasteless joke that I would not dream of making today about anyone” was submitted to him by the Comedy Awards writing team at the time. Watch on Deadline “I believed that the punchline was a reference to the fact he had publicly dated younger women, exaggerated for comic effect,” said Ross. “Had I had any reason to suspect that it might be referring to actual events, I would not only have refused to use it, but I would not have felt comfortable continuing a personal or professional relationship with him. I also like to think that I would have acted upon that knowledge.” Ross’ association with Walliams and Brand has been scrutinized in recent days. Along with the Comedy Awards joke, The Guardian published an image of Ross with Walliams at a charity quiz. In the photo, Ross is sat at a table while Walliams has his arm around an 18-year-old who accused Walliams of “pleading with me to share a bed with him” and “putting his head in my lap and making me stroke his head.” There is no suggestion that Ross was aware of any of the behavior Walliams has been accused of. Ross’ past association with Brand, who was jailed earlier this week for 10-and-a-half years for rape and sexual assault, has also come up in recent days. The pair created scandal in 2008 for prank calling Fawlty Towers actor Andrew Sachs and making lewd comments about his granddaughter, who had previously been in a relationship with Brand. After trying to have the articles blocked via the courts, the Walliams allegations dominated the news agenda yesterday and have called into question a culture that previously allowed men like Walliams and Brand to flourish. Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy said “the allegations are the latest in a long line of reported abuses of power in an industry where we have known for so long that the power imbalances are huge.” Walliams has been dropped by his agent and his shows including Little Britain have been removed from BBC iPlayer. He is accused of using his celebrity to prey on women as young as 15, making contact with them through work, including on Britain’s Got Talent , to pursue them for sexual purposes. Deadline has contacted Walliams’ legal representatives for comment. In a statement to ITV News, Walliams denied all allegations against him. When trying to prevent publication of the articles, Walliams’ lawyers revealed that he had made two attempts to take his life because of the allegations. “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law,” Walliams said. “I am devastated that some of the women I met ten to twenty years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me.” He continued: “Looking back, I realise that at times I behaved thoughtlessly towards other people I had casual sexual relationships with… I realise I did not always take people’s feelings properly into account. That is something I regret. And whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline Thriller ‘The Writer’; Latest News ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Read More About: Comments

title: Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions
full_text: Skip to main content By Matthew Carey Matthew Carey Documentary Editor, Awards @mattcarey More Stories By Matthew Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates Oscar Winner David Dinerstein Boards ‘Room Of The Absolute’ As EP; Award-Winning Doc Creates Portrait Of Ukrainian Artist Alla Hurenko View All November 11, 2026 2:02am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'The Big Boom!' Mira Film Basel GmbH EXCLUSIVE: Lightdox has acquired world sales rights to The Big Boom! ahead of its world premiere in the Frontlight section of International Documentary Festival Amsterdam ( IDFA ). Swiss filmmaker Gabriel Tejedor directed the feature documentary that explores “the contradictions of a Bulgarian town pulled into Europe’s shifting geopolitical order, where arms production for Ukraine’s front lines collides with enduring ties to Russia, personal convictions, and the everyday need to survive.” The Big Boom! premieres at IDFA on Saturday. Watch the film’s trailer below. Related Stories Documentary Riz Ahmed Boards Elham Ehsas' Short Film 'Forgotten Spaceman' About Afghanistan's First Astronaut Documentary IDFA Announces Competition Lineups, Adds 'Musk' And Elizabeth Holmes Documentary 'You Can See Everything' The documentary contrasts ancient traditions in Kazanlak, Bulgaria’s “Valley of Roses,” with the town’s major industry – the Arsenal weapons factory. That defense contractor, founded in the 19 th century, “provides work for thousands of people manufacturing weapons and ammunition,” according to a synopsis. “Through the lives of four residents, Tejedor examines the place this industry occupies in the town’s economy and identity, and the questions it raises for those whose lives depend on it.” Watch on Deadline Mira Film Basel GmbH “ The Big Boom! brings us face to face with a contradiction at the heart of today’s Europe – a town making the weapons of war while struggling with its own loyalties and beliefs,” commented Lightdox CEO Anna Berthollet. “Gabriel Tejedor finds a way into this reality that feels both clear-eyed and deeply human. As someone of Bulgarian origin myself, I find his sensitive portrayal of Kazanlak and its people particularly meaningful. He reveals the layers of history, identity and geopolitical influence that shape the region without reducing them to a political argument. We’re delighted to bring this timely film to audiences worldwide.” The Big Boom! is the fifth feature directed by Tejedor, the filmmaker and journalist “whose work explores utopias and the relationship between individuals and authority across the former Soviet Union and its satellite states.” Director Gabriel Tejedor Mira Film Basel GmbH “I have never been interested in war or weapons. But the invasion of Ukraine shattered my convictions,” Tejedor said in a statement. “Ever since, one question has haunted me: what does it mean to be a pacifist today? I do not judge the workers at Arsenal, nor the local population. The Big Boom! does not seek to lecture, but to confront the grey zones of a continent trapped in its own paradoxes.” ‘ The Big Boom! ‘ Mira Film Basel GmbH The film is a production of Mira Film Basel GmbH, co-produced by RTS Radio Télévision Suisse, SRG SSR, with the support of Swiss and regional film funds and cultural institutions. Susanna Guggenberger produced The Big Boom! Cinematography is by Thomas Szczepanski; Christine Hoffet edited the film. The score is composed by Petar Dundakov. title: How The ‘Married At First Sight UK’ Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World
full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max James Graham’s BBC Drama ‘Sherwood’ To End After Season 3 Entertainment 360 Acquires Max Stein’s Brigade Netflix’s ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ Beats ‘Mr Nobody Against Putin’ To Top Prize At UK Grierson Documentary Awards View All November 11, 2026 3:37am Add us as a Google Preferred Source EXCLUSIVE: The team behind Married at First Sight ( MAFS ) Australia is “reviewing” Channel 4’s report into the show, which has been axed in the UK following rape allegations. Deadline asked some of the teams behind versions of MAFS around the world whether they will take heed of the report. Australian broadcaster Channel Nine and MAFS producer Endemol Shine Australia told us they are “examining the findings,” while noting “many of the recommendations for improvement are already in place for MAFS Australia .” “We are always reviewing our participant protocols to ensure our participants’ safety and wellbeing,” added a spokeswoman for Endemol Shine Australia. “Production of MAFS Australia continues.” Related Stories News Channel 4 Cancels 'Married At First Sight UK' After Rape Allegations News Matthew Weiner Exits Eddie Murphy Peacock Series 'The Chairman' As Showrunner Channel 4 axed MAFS UK following rape allegations revealed earlier this year by BBC News, which the men accused of wrongdoing deny. Following these allegations being made public, two reviews were commissioned by Channel 4 CEO Priya Dogra, one examining welfare protocols and the other looking into whether changes should be made to protocols to strengthen contributor welfare in the future. While the latter, penned by ex-BBC One boss Lorraine Heggessey, suggested MAFS UK could continue if it took in some changes, Dogra axed the show last week. Watch on Deadline Many of the versions around the world are made by different production outfits than MAFS UK such as MAFS Australia , which is produced by Banijay-owned Endemol Shine Australia while the UK version is overseen by Seven.One Studios -owned CPL. The two versions are “separate productions and separate shows,” according to the Endemol Shine Australia spokeswoman. Deadline understands MAFS Australia protocols already in place that were suggested by Heggessey include cast being allowed to keep in touch with friends and family outside the show, a regular refresh of the show’s psychologists, and keeping casting and welfare teams separate. The Australia team have separate issues they are dealing with. New South Wales Police told BBC News last month that inquiries had taken place “following a report of inappropriate content being shared.” Channel Nine has confirmed that it is “aware of a police investigation.” There were also allegations, published by BBC News, that contestants were not told about their on-screen partners’ previous criminal convictions. Responding in a joint statement, Channel Nine and Endemol Shine Australia said they had “strong protocols in place to ensure participant safety and wellbeing.” In the U.S., MAFS is made by another different company, North Road-owned Kinetic Content. A spokeswoman declined comment on the Channel 4 review and whether MAFS could implement some of the recommendations in the States. We understand the American version is not currently filming and hasn’t been picked up for new seasons at this point. ‘MAFS UK’ still on sale MAFS is one of the world’s most successful formats. It originated in Denmark, where it still airs on local network DR1, produced by Seven.One-owned Snowman Productions. Seven.One told us other versions around the world that it controls remain business as usual, while its distribution arm will continue selling older editions of MAFS UK to global buyers. A Seven.One spokeswoman said: “The external reviews of contributor welfare on Married at First Sight UK confirmed that Channel 4 and production company CPL’s welfare protocols were compliant with the Ofcom Broadcasting Code; the Heggessey review found that they were ‘extensive, extremely thorough and of a high standard from which other productions in the industry have learnt’. Despite the findings of the reviews, Channel 4 has made the independent strategic decision not to continue the show. This decision has no impact on the show in other countries.” In the UK, however, the fallout from the cancelation continues. Its axing came on the day Russell Brand, a former Channel 4 presenter, was found guilty of rape and sexual assault . Several days later, allegations of sexually exploitative behavior towards women and teenagers were published about Little Britain co-creator David Walliams, who denies the allegations and says “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law.” Channel 4 is moving on from MAFS . All past seasons of MAFS UK plus the American, Australian and New Zealand versions have been removed from Channel 4’s VoD platform, while a planned spin-off has been cancelled. Channel 4 boss Dogra was merely a few weeks into the job when the MAFS UK allegations broke. She will likely face questions on the show when she appears in front of a parliamentary committee on Tuesday and has said its “considerable budget” will now be used to “find the next generation of distinctive and disruptive British television.” This will be a key task for new programs chief David Brindley, who starts in a few weeks’ time.
